scenes.caption: Bedtime.
scenes.say: It is bedtime. Omar's night light flickers.

scenes.caption: Dark.
scenes.say: The room goes dark. Omar feels a little scared.

scenes.caption: Plop.
scenes.say: He thinks of Plop, the owl afraid of the dark.

scenes.caption: Kind people.
scenes.say: Plop met kind people. They showed him good things about the dark.

scenes.caption: Stars.
scenes.say: Omar looks at the window. He sees the stars.

scenes.caption: Breathing.
scenes.say: He takes a slow, deep breath. He says a bedtime dua.

scenes.caption: Cosy.
scenes.say: The dark feels soft and cosy. He is not afraid.

scenes.caption: Goodnight.
scenes.say: Omar sleeps. The dark can be kind, just like Plop learned.
